title: Jovial Malaysian Pasta Bake
description: A flavorful and earthy pasta bake dish with malaysian spices, best served with a side of jovial company.

ingredients.name: linguine
ingredients.notes: any long, flat pasta will do

instructions: Cook linguine according to package instructions, set aside.
In a large pan, heat oil over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add ginger and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Stir in curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in chicken/vegetable broth and coconut milk, bring to a simmer.
Add cooked linguine and toss to coat with sauce.
Transfer to a baking dish and top with pasta, chopped onion, and cilantro.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, until the top is golden brown and the pasta is heated through.
